skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: A Gallant Dream
skins.content: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/A Gallant Dream. Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.
skins.quote: A thousand years of wandering passed in a flash. All truths, all lies, all but a dream. Outside my tent, the wind howls as it ever has. My lord awakens, so I too awake.

skins.name: It Does Wash the Strings
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/It Does Wash the Strings. Robe made from white cloth, with loose-fitting sleeves that reach to knee level. A lucky animal is weaved onto the skirt, inspired by a dream the client had.
skins.quote: 'Who am I?' 'What am I?' 'Where do I go?' 'Thunder with no rain, bones to dust. The dreamer must wake, the calm be disturbed. Why ask?'

skins.name: Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia. Stylish and classic. The wind brushes the cliffs for a thousand years, a thousand li, brushing against the wanderer's robes, brushing into dream.
skins.usage: Outfit worn by Ling for long trips.
skins.quote: 'How many starry nights must the long wind blow, and how many springs and autumns must the snowmelt wash, before the wonders of blooming gravel are revealed?'
